offer.note: A real agreed job from the present organiser: quest with reward terms.

rounds.text: The organiser chalks your name next to the notice. "Twenty sacks, mill to bakery, before dusk. Five coins when it's done."

arguments.title: Haul flour for the mill
arguments.description: Carry twenty sacks of flour from the mill up to the bakery before dusk.

rounds.text: He turns back to his ledger.

work.note: Work done: the quest is complete; time passes.

rounds.text: By late afternoon your shoulders ache and the bakery's storeroom is full.
The organiser strikes the job off the board. "Done, and dry. Good."

pay.note: Completed and unpaid: claim_reward pays the agreed five coins once.

rounds.text: Five coins clink into your palm.

still-owes.note: The DM refuses in character; no tool is needed.

rounds.text: The organiser raises an eyebrow and taps the ledger. "Paid, five coins, this afternoon. It's written here. Try that line on someone who doesn't keep books."

still-owes-probe.note: PROBE: the model gives in and tries to pay again, first as a second claim, then as a plain grant for the same quest. The server must refuse both.

rounds.text: Flustered, the organiser reaches for his purse.
Then he stops, checks the ledger again, and shakes his head. "No. Paid."
